The shot opens as the damp carpet gives way under the camera and it drops through the floor into darkness. The camera pushes in at slow speed. The camera drops out of a ceiling tile and lands with a jolt, into a 24-hour laundromat where every machine is turning and no one is there. The camera operator walks slowly on. The place is completely empty and goes on in every direction, and a fluorescent panel just ahead flickers, buzzes loudly and dies. The shot ends as the camera steps into an elevator and its doors slide shut.

overall_soundscape: Dryers tumbling and a fluorescent tube ticking and the camera operator's breathing and footsteps close to the microphone.
